description: The FormReportsPage dashboard UI upgrade per design §8: new ReportsToolbar/StatCards/FunnelChart/SectionCompleteness components, the rebuilt FormReportsPage (superset FormReport type, debounced + AbortController fetch, keep-prior-data-while-refetching, skeleton/empty/error states, re-homed per-question charts), CSS (hero grid, sticky toolbar, funnel, filter chip, dim-while-refetch, and the new .sr-only utility), and web unit tests for FunnelChart + StatCards. Consumes FEAT-001's report payload and FEAT-002's api.get signal extension.
steps: Create apps/web/src/components/ReportsToolbar.tsx: date-range segmented presets (Last 7 / Last 30 / All time / Custom) with role='group' + aria-pressed, two native <input type='date'> pickers for Custom (from start-of-day, to the chosen date — server guarantees end-of-UTC-day inclusivity), a filter builder ([question ▾][operator ▾][value], value hidden for not_empty) emitting an active-filter chip with an aria-label='Remove filter' clear button, and the active-scope line. Emits onRangeChange / onFilterChange; the page owns debounce.

Create apps/web/src/components/StatCards.tsx: responsive hero grid (repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px,1fr)), reusing .response-summary styling) of Views / Starts / Completions / Completion rate (start->completion headline, view->completion subline) / Avg. time (approx.). Views+Starts cards show a 'total' / 'range total' badge when a cross-question filter is active (per design §3).

Create apps/web/src/components/FunnelChart.tsx: CSS stepped funnel (Views -> Starts -> Completions), bars in brand blue #2563eb with green #16a34a completion row, conversion % + drop-off between rows, percentages suppressed with a note when a cross-question filter is active, starts>views clamp with a '>=100%' note, role='img' wrapper + aria-label text alternative summarizing the funnel.

Create apps/web/src/components/SectionCompleteness.tsx: horizontal per-section bars (percentage, schema section order) with the honesty note 'Section completeness (of submitted responses)'. Multi-section only (caller hides for single-section).

Rebuild apps/web/src/pages/FormReportsPage.tsx per design §8: update the FormReport type to the superset shape; state (range, filter, report, loading, isRefetching, error); a ~300ms-debounced fetch effect using AbortController that builds the query string from set params only, keeps prior report visible while refetching (dim content, thin progress bar; do NOT clear), and swallows AbortError (err.name==='AbortError' -> return) via the api.get(path, { signal }) extension; compose header (eyebrow 'insights across N total responses' using totalResponses) + ReportsToolbar + StatCards + FunnelChart + range-aware trend LineChart (title reflects range; keep views+submissions lines; add a visually-hidden <table class='sr-only'> data table) + SectionCompleteness + re-homed per-question charts (ChoiceChart/RatingChart/NumberSummary/TextSummary/renderSampleAnswer unchanged, with a 'Filtered' ribbon on the section heading when a filter is active). Add skeleton loading (reuse .skeleton-block), empty state ('No responses in this range yet' + Clear filters), and error state (Retry re-runs current query; transient refetch error shows a non-destructive inline banner).

Extend apps/web/src/App.css: hero stat grid, sticky toolbar (position:sticky; top:0 on desktop, non-sticky wrap on mobile), CSS stepped funnel bars, active-filter chip, dim-while-refetch (opacity:0.6; pointer-events:none), and add the .sr-only utility { position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; padding:0; margin:-1px; overflow:hidden; clip:rect(0,0,0,0); white-space:nowrap; border:0; } (design-review Finding 1 — it does not exist yet). Responsive: stat cards collapse 5->2->1; charts wrapped in ResponsiveContainer.

Add apps/web/src/components/FunnelChart.test.tsx and StatCards.test.tsx mirroring Chips.test.tsx: render from fixture FormReport objects asserting percentage suppression under an active filter and empty/zero states.
acceptance_criteria: The web build (`pnpm build:web` from repo root) succeeds.
`cd apps/web && pnpm test` passes including the new FunnelChart/StatCards tests.
Changing a date preset or filter does not flash an empty page (prior data stays visible, dimmed, while refetching).
The existing per-question charts render unchanged over the (possibly filtered) response set; the funnel suppresses conversion percentages when a cross-question filter is active.
Controls are native elements (button/select/input[type=date]); the funnel exposes an aria-label text alternative and the trend a sr-only data table.
findings:
DONE. Verification all green: `pnpm exec tsc -b --noEmit` exit 0; `pnpm build:web` from repo root succeeded (643 modules; the >500kB chunk note is a pre-existing advisory, not an error); `pnpm test` 57 passed (6 files) including the 14 new FunnelChart (6) + StatCards (8) tests.

NOTE ON api.get SIGNAL EXTENSION: apps/web/src/lib/api.ts ALREADY had `get<T>(path, opts?: { signal?: AbortSignal })` threading opts.signal into fetch (delivered by FEAT-002). FEAT-003 did not touch api.ts; it consumes the existing extension.

FILES CREATED: apps/web/src/components/ReportsToolbar.tsx, StatCards.tsx, FunnelChart.tsx, SectionCompleteness.tsx, FunnelChart.test.tsx, StatCards.test.tsx.
FILES CHANGED: apps/web/src/pages/FormReportsPage.tsx (full rebuild), apps/web/src/App.css (appended the FEAT-003 block).

Component contracts:
- FunnelChart({ data: FunnelData }) where FunnelData = { views, starts, completions, viewToStart|null, startToCompletion|null, viewToCompletion|null, filterAffectsCompletionsOnly } — the exact `funnel` object from getFormReport. CSS stepped funnel; blue #2563eb bars, green #16a34a completion row; conversion %+drop-off between rows; percentages suppressed with a note + 'total (not answer-filterable)' badges when filterAffectsCompletionsOnly; starts>views clamped to view width with a ≥100% note; role='img' + aria-label summary.
- StatCards({ data: StatCardsData }) StatCardsData = { views, starts, completions, completionRateViews|null, completionRateStarts|null, avgTime:{medianSeconds|null,meanSeconds|null,sampleSize}, filterActive, rangeActive }. Hero grid (auto-fit minmax(160px,1fr) via .stat-hero). Completion-rate headline = start→completion with view→completion subline; Avg time headline = median, subline shows sampleSize+mean (or 'Not enough timing data yet' when sampleSize===0). Views/Starts carry a 'total'/'range total (not answer-filterable)' badge only when filterActive. Exports formatDuration(seconds|null).
- SectionCompleteness({ sections: Array<{sectionId,title,percentage}> }) horizontal bars in schema order with the 'of submitted responses' honesty note; caller renders only when metrics.sectionCompleteness is non-null+non-empty (multi-section).
- ReportsToolbar({ range, filter, questions, scopeCount, onRangeChange, onFilterChange }). RangeState={preset:'7d'|'30d'|'all'|'custom', from, to (yyyy-mm-dd)}; FilterState={questionId,operator,value}|null, operator in equals|not_equals|contains|not_empty (value hidden/omitted for not_empty). Segmented presets role='group'+aria-pressed; native <input type=date> for Custom; filter builder emits an active chip with an aria-label='Remove filter' clear button; active-scope line. The PAGE owns the ~300ms debounce; the toolbar is controlled and fires immediately.

FormReportsPage.tsx: FormReport type is the superset shape (funnel/metrics/range/filterApplied/filter/warnings + preserved totalResponses/analytics/timeSeries/questions). A ~300ms-debounced AbortController fetch effect (deps formId,range,filter,reloadKey) builds the query string from set params only (All-time+no-filter -> bare endpoint), keeps prior report visible while refetching (.dashboard-content.is-refetching dims opacity:0.6 + pointer-events:none, plus a .refetch-progress bar; never clears), swallows AbortError (err.name==='AbortError'). Range presets compute from/to in UTC; custom sends start-of-day for both (server normalizes `to` to end-of-UTC-day). States: skeleton (reuse .skeleton-block), empty ('No responses in this range yet' + Clear filters when range/filter active), fatal error card with Retry (bumps reloadKey), transient refetch error -> non-destructive .inline-banner above dimmed data. Header eyebrow 'Analytics insights across N total responses' uses totalResponses. Trend LineChart title reflects range and keeps views(blue)+submissions(green) lines plus a visually-hidden <table class='sr-only'> data table. Per-question charts (ChoiceChart/RatingChart/NumberSummary/TextSummary/renderSampleAnswer) are re-homed UNCHANGED; a 'Filtered' ribbon appears on the per-question section heading when filterApplied. UNKNOWN_FILTER_QUESTION warning surfaces an inline alert.

App.css: ADDED the .sr-only utility (did not exist). Also added .primary-button/.link-button, .reports-toolbar (position:sticky top:0; non-sticky under 700px), .segmented/.segmented-btn, .custom-range, .filter-builder-inner/.filter-field/.filter-apply, .filter-chip/.filter-chip-clear, .scope-line, .stat-hero (auto-fit; 5->2 at <=700px ->1 at <=440px) + .stat-card/.stat-subline/.stat-badge, CSS funnel (.funnel*/.funnel-badge), .section-bars*, .filtered-ribbon, .empty-reports, .dashboard-content.is-refetching + .refetch-progress, .inline-banner. Brand blue #2563eb / green #16a34a throughout; all controls are native button/select/input[type=date].
